main_turf.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise (left-handed). Situated inside a bend of the Swan River in Perth. A 1,699m oval with a 333m home straight constructed on a high-draining StrathAyr surface. Serves as Perth's primary metropolitan venue during the wet WA winter months (May through October) while Ascot is resting.
main_turf.post_bias: Fair, but inside barriers (1–4) in 1000m, 1200m, and 1400m sprint chutes are advantageous to hold position before the main turn. In heavy winter track conditions, wide sweeps coming into the 333m stretch are common.

handicapping_angles.perth_winter_mudlark_specialists: Belmont hosts Perth's winter metropolitan racing. While the StrathAyr base drains well, heavy winter rain produces Soft 6 to Heavy 10 tracks. Heavily upgrade proven WA winter mud-runners ('Mudlarks') with 2+ wins on wet tracks.
handicapping_angles.the_wizard_william_pike_factor: William Pike ('The Wizard') is the dominant jockey in Western Australia. His late-closing swoops down the Belmont straight are legendary. Always grant a bonus when Pike is riding for top yards (Neville Parnham, Adam Durrant, Grant & Alana Williams).
handicapping_angles.ascot_to_belmont_seasonal_switch: Track-form switches between Ascot (summer/autumn) and Belmont (winter/spring) are critical. Agile, tactical runners and wet-trackers thrive at Belmont, whereas long-striding firm-ground gallopers excel at Ascot.
handicapping_angles.perth_metro_stable_dominance: Leading WA trainers (Neville Parnham, Adam Durrant, Simon A. Miller, Dan & Ben Pearce, Mitchell Pateman) dominate Belmont Saturday Metro cards.
